prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-36856 for Bramblecote Studio
prose.body:
Hi Bramblecote Studio team,

Hope you're having a great week! Just a quick and friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-36856, which is currently outstanding. The total amount due is 8318.76 USDC.

To settle this balance, please send the payment to our standard vendor wallet: 0x917dedeb0f0eeb54db6220f341660bc01793b1c8. This is the same address we’ve used for previous transactions, so no need to worry about new details.

If you’ve already sent this, please feel free to ignore this note. If you need a copy of the invoice or have any questions, just reply to this email or reach out to our accounts receivable team. We truly appreciate your prompt attention to this.

Thanks so much for your business and continued partnership!

Best regards,
Elmstead Facilities Accounting Team
